# Brownza

> Brownza is a cloud bakery based in Karachi, Pakistan. It has no physical
> storefront — every order is baked fresh to order and delivered directly to
> the customer's door within Karachi.

Brownza specializes in Nutella-filled cookies, fudge brownies (including a
build-your-own customizable box), steamed dumplings, and oven-baked lasagna.
Orders are placed online and paid for via bank transfer or mobile wallet;
Brownza does not currently offer cash on delivery.

## Key facts

- Business type: cloud bakery / online dessert delivery (no dine-in, no physical shop to visit)
- City served: Karachi, Pakistan
- Categories: cookies, brownies, steamed dumplings, lasagna
- Ordering: online only, via the website
- Payment: online bank transfer / mobile wallet (no cash on delivery)
- Delivery: flat delivery charge across served Karachi areas (DHA, Clifton, Gulshan-e-Iqbal, Gulistan-e-Johar, Nazimabad, North Nazimabad, PECHS, Bahadurabad, Malir, Scheme 33, Korangi, Saddar, and more)

## Pages

- [Menu](https://brownza.shop/products): the full product catalogue, browsable by category.
- [Pre-Order](https://brownza.shop/pre-order): custom/bulk order requests for occasions needing advance notice.
- [Order Tracking](https://brownza.shop/track): live status of a placed order.
